head: bb7eae0965786ee428131557d9560f58d26bf892
title: fix(coach): Clients list rows carry last active day and check-ins to review (UX-COACHLOOKUP-124)
body:
UX-COACHLOOKUP-124 (agent 124). T3: changes the GET /coach/clients response (additive block, two token columns removed, profile consent-gated).

## Why
The coach's Clients list shows only name, email and "active" for every client: nothing tells the coach who logged today, who has gone quiet, or who has a check-in waiting. Top-tier coaching apps show this on the row.

## What
- `CoachService.withRosterActivity` (called by the GET /coach/clients handler): adds `activity` per row:
  `shared`, `last_active_on`, `last_food_on`, `last_workout_on`, `last_weigh_in_on`, `last_check_in_on` (YYYY-MM-DD logged day) and `check_ins_to_review`.
  Five grouped queries per page (`groupBy user_id` with `_max date` on the existing `(user_id, date)` indexes), never one per client.
- Consent: same per-scope rule as the client summary and timeline (`loadFitnessConsents` / `ConsentService.coachCanAccess`): one batched `clientCoachConsent.findMany` per page, `ConsentService.rowIsGranted`, owner bypass. A scope the client has not shared is `null`.
- Privacy: the roster used to send the full `profile` (weight, birth date, injuries) to every coach even when the client had not shared body metrics, while the client summary hides it. The roster now follows the summary rule. `deletion_token_hash`, `deletion_token_expires_at` and `expo_push_token` are no longer sent (no reader uses them).
- `getClients` itself is unchanged (existing tenancy and sub-coach tests still cover it).

## Readers checked
Mobile readers of /coach/clients (coachStore, programsApi.assignableClients, coach SettingsScreen) read `id`, `name`, `email`, `role`, `coach_id`, `archived_at`, `created_at` only. All unchanged.

## Tests
`test/coach-roster-activity.spec.ts` (new, fails on main: the activity block does not exist): per-scope slices, revoked consent hidden, profile only with body metrics, tokens never sent, owner bypass, empty page makes no queries.

Mobile pair: growth-project-mobile#408 (branch agent124/ux-coach-lookup) reads `activity` when present and falls back cleanly when absent, so either merge order is safe.
